question: Where is Indian Institute of Skiing and Mountaineering situated?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Gulmarg**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **IISM **is a modern and the most popular ski training institute in our country which was established by the Ministry of Tourism, Govt. of India at Gulmarg in **1968** as a temporary project called **Gulmarg Winter Sports Project **(GWSP). 
 
• The initial project envisaged the development of Gulmarg as an international **ski resort** with the desired infrastructure and training ski guides to meet the requirement of tourists. 
 
• The ski hire shop was established along with a chairlift and a ski lift in the early 70s to promote skiing and adventure tourism amongst domestic and foreign tourists. 
 
• It also proposed to establish a cable car (Gandola) between **Gulmarg and Kongdori.** 
 
• The project was started in the borrowed huts of the Tourism department of J&K.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Jammu and Kashmir have 2 capitals: **Srinagar - The summer Capital, Jammu - Winter capital.**
 
• **Manoj Sinha** took charge as the Lieutenant Governor of Jammu and Kashmir on the 7th of August,2020 at Raj Bhavan, Srinagar.
